trailhead.label: Vigo di Fassa (stazione a monte funivia Ciampedie), the APT’s start

cautions: Wide gravel forest track at about 1,950–2,000 m.
You reach the start by the Catinaccio cable car from Vigo: a lead and muzzle are required on board.
Busy with families round Ciampedie and Gardeccia in summer.
Carry water even though water points are listed.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
